verdict: Ads paused mid-period; GBP and Instagram activity also stalled.
narrative: All 14 leads and the full $259.95 in ad spend came from a single week, September 5–11. Meta ads went dark on September 12 and have not run since, which means the past three weeks produced no paid activity. Alongside that, Google Business Profile actions dropped 43% week-over-week and Instagram reach fell 50%, with both showing zero activity for the last three days of the period. Ads are being reactivated and several overdue setup milestones — including attribution and reporting — are being resolved so the next period has a clean, full 28-day run to measure against.

watch_item.issue: Ads have been paused since September 12, and the last three days show zero organic profile and social activity as well — a full stop across paid and organic channels.
watch_item.fix: Meta campaigns are being reactivated this week, and intake tracking is being reviewed to close the gap between leads recorded in ads and opportunities logged in the CRM.
